findings.current: As I ran forward at full speed, I spotted a wall of flame blocking the path about a dozen yards ahead and reached toward the air.
findings.defect: 십여 장 is a little over ten jang, roughly thirty-five to forty yards, not twelve yards. The draft substantially shortens the stated distance.
findings.rationale: The source gives the distance in 장; converting 십여 장 to “a dozen yards” changes the scene’s quantity and spatial mechanics.
findings.replacement: As I ran forward at full speed, I spotted a wall of flame blocking the path roughly forty yards ahead and reached toward the air.
findings.source: 신속하게 달려가던 나는 십여 장 앞을 가로막은 화염의 벽을 확인하고 허공을 향해 손을 뻗었다.

findings.defect: The draft changes the inclusive “Let’s go” into a command telling Muyaho to go alone.
findings.rationale: 가자 includes both Jin and Muyaho, consistent with Jin remaining mounted as they proceed together.

findings.current: Soon after, I noticed that the foul smell seeping through the acrid smoke was the scent of human blood.
findings.defect: “Foul” replaces the specifically metallic or coppery quality of 비릿한 that allows Jin to identify the smell as blood.
findings.rationale: The source preserves a concrete sensory cue connecting the smell to human blood rather than describing it only as generically unpleasant.
findings.replacement: Soon after, I realized that the metallic smell seeping through the acrid smoke was the scent of human blood.
findings.source: 이내 매캐한 연기 사이로 스며드는 비릿한 냄새가 인간의 혈향(血香)이라는 것을 깨달았다.

findings.current: The poison-warding pearl wasn’t enough for it to chew on, so it gulped it down instead.
findings.defect: The draft awkwardly implies that the pearl was insufficient for chewing and therefore had to be swallowed. The source’s joke is an escalation: merely biting or holding it was not enough for Muyaho, so it swallowed the pearl whole.
findings.rationale: 물다 못해 presents swallowing as an excessive step beyond biting down on the pearl, not as a consequence of the pearl being unsuitable or insufficient for chewing.
findings.replacement: As if biting down on the poison-warding pearl weren’t enough, it gulped the thing down whole.
findings.source: 피독주를 물다 못해 꿀꺽 삼켜 버린 녀석은 기민한 반사신경으로 곳곳에서 밀려오는 독물들을 처리했고, 경신법 좀 익혔다는 절정 고수들도 주저할 만큼 큰 폭을 가진 늪을 단 한 번의 도약으로 뛰어넘었다.

findings.current: Even I, who had grown rapidly through countless trials and life-or-death battles based on the System, couldn’t dare guarantee victory against them.
findings.defect: “Countless trials” obscures the explicit 수많은 단련, omitting repeated martial training as one of the mechanisms behind Jin’s rapid growth.
findings.rationale: The source separately credits the System, extensive training, and battles that crossed the line of death; “trials” does not preserve the concrete training component.
findings.replacement: Even I, who had used the System as a foundation to grow rapidly through relentless training and countless life-or-death battles, couldn’t dare guarantee victory against them.
findings.source: 특히 내가 직접 부딪혀 보기까지 한 혈주와 서천마군의 무위는…… 시스템을 바탕삼아 수많은 단련과 사선을 넘나드는 전투로 급성장한 지금의 나조차 감히 승리를 장담할 수 없을 정도다.

findings.current: I reaffirmed in body and mind the no-turning-back mindset that was an essential virtue for the successor of the Fire Gate Clan and the heir of the Fire King, then thrust one palm toward the Poison Mist.
findings.defect: The neutral “no-turning-back mindset” loses the deliberately slangy, comedic register of 노빠꾸 정신.
findings.rationale: 노빠꾸 is blunt slang literally invoking having no reverse gear; “no-brakes mentality” preserves the irreverent register and punchline without changing the action.
findings.replacement: I reaffirmed in body and mind the no-brakes mentality that was an essential virtue for the successor of the Fire Gate Clan and the heir of the Fire King, then thrust one palm toward the Poison Mist.
findings.source: 열화문의 계승자이자 화왕의 후인이 갖춰야 할 필수 덕목, 노빠꾸 정신을 몸과 마음에 되새긴 나는 독무를 향해 일장(一掌)을 뻗었다.

findings.current: As I glared at the paths finally revealed, tangled together like a maze, I infused them with my internal energy and shouted as if roaring.
findings.defect: The pronoun “them” makes Jin infuse the revealed paths with internal energy. In the source, he projects his shout or voice with internal energy.
findings.rationale: 공력을 실어 modifies how Jin delivers the ensuing shout; it does not describe channeling internal energy into the paths.
findings.replacement: As I glared at the maze of tangled paths that had finally been revealed, I infused my voice with internal energy and roared.
findings.source: 마침내 환하게 드러난 미로처럼 얽힌 길을 노려보던 나는, 공력을 실어 포효하듯 내질렀다.

findings.current: Yohi found this side of Heugung strange. He was always grinning foolishly and calling her “big sister,” but that wasn’t important right now.
findings.defect: “Big sister” reverses the kinship direction. Yohi has just addressed Heugung as 오라버니, her older brother, while Heugung habitually calls her 누이; the established intimate rendering is “my dear.”
findings.rationale: 누이 cannot mean that Yohi is Heugung’s older sister in this exchange, and the established address relationship calls for Heugung’s affectionate “my dear.”
findings.replacement: Yohi found this side of Heugung—who usually wore a goofy grin and called her “my dear”—strange, but that wasn’t what mattered right now.
findings.source: 요희는 언제나 헤실헤실 웃으며 누이라 부르던 흑웅의 이와 같은 모습이 낯설게 느껴졌지만, 지금 당장은 그게 중요한 것이 아니었다.

summary: Several fidelity issues alter a distance, an inclusive command, a growth mechanism, a qi-projection action, and Heugung’s address for Yohi. There are also localized sensory, humor, and register losses.
